question: What efficacy is attributed to the mantra identified as the consort of fire?
premises: The mantra is called the consort of fire.
It is said to grant all accomplishments.
inference: The fire-consort mantra is proclaimed as capable of granting all accomplishments.
uncertainties: 'vahnibhāryā' may refer to the bīja svāhā; kept as given.
plain_english: The mantra known as the consort of fire is declared to be the giver of all accomplishments.
